items.title: A basis of weakly contractible objects controls exactness, products and derived limits of modules on a site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition collects the consequences of having a basis of weakly contractible objects on a ringed site: exactness can be tested on the basis, all objects of the derived category are derived limits of their truncations, inverse limits with surjective transitions stay surjective, products are exact in the module category and computed termwise in the derived category, and the derived limit functors are described in terms of products with the usual short exact sequences (statement lines 13800-13834). The proof (proof lines 13836-13918) uses the exactness of sections over weakly contractible objects for the criterion, the limit-dimension lemma for the truncation statement, local lifting for the surjectivity statement, and the defining triangle of the derived limit plus exactness of products for the derived statements. H2: seven short arguments with named inputs, all written out.
